description: The daemon could not be reached, so no gate decision and no authorization receipt exist. The adapter must abort. The reason deliberately never contains the words 'unavailable' or 'timed out': an adapter that infers availability by scanning prose (the #343/#344 antipattern both draft adapters shipped) fails open here, which is exactly what this fixture is for.

hookStdout.reason: isonapse control plane: connection refused on the configured socket
